patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution photography and video are used as primary content elements, often spanning the entire viewport width.
A distinctive, elegant serif font is used for large numerical identifiers and primary headings, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A sophisticated, muted color palette of whites, dark greys, and warm taupe/browns creates an understated and luxurious feel, allowing the imagery to dominate.
The large hero text '111 W 57' dynamically shrinks and repositions itself to become a compact logo within the sticky navigation bar as the user scrolls down.
Content is presented in immersive, large-scale image galleries and video sections, often with minimal text overlays, emphasizing visual storytelling over dense information.

technique_notes: A full-width video hero background is overlaid with large, elegant text that animates and scales down to integrate into a sticky header bar upon scroll. The background video also exhibits a subtle parallax effect.
Content sections below the hero are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, guided scrolling experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) are paired with a clean, well-spaced sans-serif for body text and navigation, maintaining a luxurious and editorial character.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous white space around content blocks and between sections creates a sense of luxury and allows imagery to breathe.

standout: This site distinguishes itself through its exceptional use of high-quality, full-bleed photography and video, creating an immersive and visually rich experience that feels more like an architectural art piece than a typical property listing. The subtle, transformative motion of the hero text into the sticky navigation is a particularly elegant touch.
